svg.title: Unified context layer for telco agents
svg.desc: Telco source data lands in OneLake. Four Direct Lake semantic models own the measures. A Fabric IQ ontology adds entity types, cross-model relationships, metrics and rules. Agents in Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot and GitHub Copilot use the ontology through the ontology MCP endpoint, a Fabric data agent and the Fabric IQ MCP server.
svg.text: Unified context layer for telco agents
